body: Lesson: an agent that records chip writes for the opt-in option must not also author the default sound for that game. Use separate agents, and name the fenced-off paths in the author's prompt. This goes into phase 5 after the sound branch lands. MAME concurrency: no clashes; scratch dirs are named by pid plus a counter or hash, and worktrees keep outputs apart. Runs slow down with 2-3 agents, but nothing has failed.
summary: Clean-room finding: the default POKEY sequences were partly written from the chip-write log, so they are stripped and a fresh agent re-authors them
